raw_segments.text: The landlord and tenant, for example,
might jointly be obliged to record their lease in a public register.
Proper penalties might be enacted against concealing
or misrepresenting any of the conditions,
and if part of those penalties were to be paid to either of the two parties
who informed against and convicted the other of such concealment or misrepresentation,
it would effectually deter them from combining together
in order to defraud the public revenue.
All the conditions of the lease might be sufficiently known from such a record.
